label: early-episode GO (plus D2 after rewarded common a2->S2)
explanation: An early-episode unit. It fires almost only in the first ~20-30 trials of an episode (rate about 25% in trials 0-19, 8% in 20-29, about 1% in 30-39, and zero from trial 40 on). In that window about 81% of its mass is at GO and about 18% at D2. It fires at D2 only when S2 is shown, nearly always on a common a2->S2 trial that follows a rewarded trial. It never fires when the reward input is 1 and almost never at D1. Over a run of similar trials the activation decays steadily as the episode goes on. Magnitude is highest at GO on a1 choices early in high_first episodes (top windows), but GO firing covers both actions. Firing also lines up with model value in [7.73, 8.10) and with large-magnitude choice logits. The predicate only uses observed variables (D2 action, state and previous reward are all known at D2). Precision is limited because not every early GO step fires, and the late part of the decaying tail is missed.
